name: HTTP Status Code Lookup
description: Look up the reason phrase and meaning of a status code, or search status codes by keyword.

hints.query: Type a status code (404), a reason phrase (not found) or a Chinese meaning (重定向); the search and the category filter combine.
hints.output: Every status code is listed by default; typing a search term or picking a category narrows the list instantly, showing status code / reason phrase / category / meaning, each row copyable.
hints.validCode: The status code is within the valid range.
hints.invalidCode: A status code must be an integer between {min} and {max}.
hints.note: Data comes from a built-in snapshot; nothing is fetched from the network.

faq.q: What happens when a status code is not in the table?
faq.a: A code between 100 and 599 that has no entry, such as 299, still returns its category so you can tell which class it belongs to; it simply has no standard reason phrase.

401 means valid authentication credentials are missing and the server expects the client to authenticate again; 403 means the server understood the request but refuses to authorize it, and re-authenticating will not help.

faq.q: Can I search with Chinese keywords?
faq.a: Yes. A keyword matches both the reason phrase and the Chinese description, so 「重定向」 lists the 3xx entries.
